beats.en: A tree has a big trunk of wood and many branches that spread out with leaves. Its roots go deep down into the soil. Mango, coconut, khejri, jackfruit, banyan, amaltas, peepal and chinar are all trees.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Getting to Know Plants · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Not all plants grow tall like trees. A shrub is a medium-sized plant with several woody stems and branches growing close to the ground.

beats.en: Not all plants grow tall like trees. A shrub is a medium-sized plant with several woody stems and branches growing close to the ground. Hibiscus, rose, tulsi and curry leaf are shrubs, and tulsi at home is a shrub too.
beats.speakEn: Not all plants grow tall like trees. A shrub is a medium-sized plant with several woody stems and branches growing close to the ground. Hibiscus, rose, tulsi and curry leaf are shrubs, and tulsi at home is a shrub too.

beats.en: Herbs are smaller plants with soft, green stems that do not become woody. Mint, tomato, coriander and mustard are herbs. Grasses are a kind of herb. Their leaves are long, thin and flat and their stems are hollow.
beats.speakEn: Herbs are smaller plants with soft, green stems that do not become woody. Mint, tomato, coriander and mustard are herbs. Grasses are a kind of herb. Their leaves are long, thin and flat and their stems are hollow.
